sloka: तत्प्रतिश्रुत्य धर्मेण न चेद्दास्यसि मे वरम् ।अद्यैव हि प्रहास्यामि जीवितं त्वद्विमानिता ॥२-११-२१॥
transliteration: tatpratiśrutya dharmeṇa na ceddāsyasi me varam ।adyaiva hi prahāsyāmi jīvitaṁ tvadvimānitā ॥2-11-21॥

translations.english: The boons you have vowed to give shall rightfully be given to me. If not, disgraced by you I shall give up my life right away.
